summary: Build practical geospatial data governance skills for quality, privacy, interoperability, and operational decisions. Explore the course and enquire today.
lede: Geospatial data governance helps GIS managers, humanitarian information managers, and programme leaders make spatial evidence usable for operational decisions. The course develops skills to assess dataset quality, build metadata profiles, and document custodianship and sharing controls. Participants also design privacy-aware workflows and map-product specifications that connect spatial information with programme decisions, with introductory coverage of AI-assisted quality screening.
audienceIntro: Geospatial data governance training suits professionals who make, manage, validate, share, or sponsor spatial information for operational programmes. It is appropriate for beginner to intermediate practitioners who already work with datasets, maps, programme evidence, or organisational data controls.
audience: Environmental Programme Managers using habitat, climate
prerequisites: Working experience with spatial datasets, maps, programme information, or organisational data controls is recommended. Basic QGIS familiarity helps but advanced GIS analysis and programming are not required. Completion does not require coding. Advanced topics such as GeoAI quality screening and automated metadata extraction are taught at conceptual and operational application level, not production-engineering level.
